english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a room, home, or other place with plenty of space.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for describing a room, home, or other interior with plenty of space.
Use this specifically for a place or space that is roomy and spacious.

examples.english: This home is spacious and bright, so it is very comfortable to live in.
examples.traditional: 呢間屋又闊落又光猛，住得好舒服。
